categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in semiconductor-related sectors, focusing on innovative optical inspection technologies, advanced packaging solutions, and process and quality assurance solutions. It provides one-stop semiconductor solutions including testing, advanced packaging, and manufacturing process quality control. Additionally, it has expanded into advanced optical fields and compound semiconductor markets such as silicon carbide (SiC) substrates and power semiconductor reliability verification.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary laser tomography scanning technology (SpiroxLTS™) for high-precision 3D imaging and non-destructive inspection of semiconductor wafers and chips. The company develops advanced optical inspection systems for silicon photonics, TSV/TGV 3D chip stacking, and compound semiconductor defect detection. It also employs innovative laser modification cutting techniques and collaborates with global partners to enhance power semiconductor dynamic reliability testing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor foundries, OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) providers, and manufacturers in the semiconductor supply chain. The company serves markets related to AI, high-performance computing, cloud data services, and emerging applications requiring advanced semiconductor packaging and inspection. It also targets compound semiconductor and power semiconductor device manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan and China, with distribution and service agreements covering these regions. It collaborates with international partners and has established a presence in the Asia-Pacific region, including cooperation with US and German laboratories for power semiconductor testing. Its products and services are marketed globally through integrated distribution channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, providing equipment and solutions for wafer testing, advanced packaging, and quality assurance. It supports foundries and OSAT companies by supplying inspection and testing tools critical for semiconductor manufacturing and packaging processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing innovative optical inspection technologies, expanding advanced packaging inspection capabilities, and commercializing nonlinear optical applications in SiC wafer cutting and silicon photonics. The company emphasizes R&D in laser tomography scanning, 3D chip inspection, and compound semiconductor process solutions to enhance product value and customer competitiveness. It also focuses on integrating complete solution kits and flexible service models aligned with market trends such as AI and advanced semiconductor packaging.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor inspection and testing equipment, including proprietary optical systems and advanced packaging tools. The company also earns income from service contracts, maintenance, and distribution agreements with semiconductor equipment manufacturers. Collaborative R&D and technology licensing with global partners contribute to its revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other semiconductor equipment providers specializing in wafer inspection, advanced packaging, and failure analysis tools. It positions itself as a technology innovator with proprietary laser tomography and 3D imaging capabilities, aiming to differentiate through integrated one-stop solutions and advanced optical technologies. Its partnerships with global instrument manufacturers and focus on emerging semiconductor markets strengthen its competitive stance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, the company recorded consolidated revenue of approximately NT$673 million, representing a significant decline compared to the previous year due to semiconductor market downturns. It reported a net loss attributable to the parent company of about NT$252 million, reflecting challenges from market cyclicality and reduced capital expenditures. Despite short-term setbacks, the company is investing in R&D and expanding its product portfolio to capture growth in emerging semiconductor applications.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering smarter, high-value solutions through its innovative laser tomography scanning technology and integrated semiconductor inspection systems. Its products offer high-precision, non-destructive 3D imaging critical for advanced packaging quality assurance and compound semiconductor manufacturing. By providing comprehensive one-stop solutions and flexible service models, it enhances customer competitiveness, environmental sustainability, and social value.
